definitions.gloss: to turn, to revolve, to rotate
definitions.explanation: To move in a circular motion around an axis or center.

definitions.gloss: to go around, to make rounds
definitions.explanation: To visit multiple places in succession.

definitions.gloss: to go via, to take a detour
definitions.explanation: To reach a destination by an indirect route.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}は{太陽|たいよう}の{周|まわ}りを{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The Earth revolves around the sun.

examples.japanese: いくつかの{店|みせ}を{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: I went around to several stores.

examples.japanese: {右|みぎ}に{回|まわ}ってください。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {回|まわ}す (transitive, to turn something). Pattern: Xが{回|まわ}る (X turns/goes around).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {回|まわ}っている = 'is turning/going around.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ぐるぐる{回|まわ}る (spin around)
・{店|みせ}を{回|まわ}る (visit stores)
・{周|まわ}りを{回|まわ}る (go around the perimeter)
・{頭|あたま}が{回|まわ}る (head spins; can think clearly)
・{血|ち}が{回|まわ}る (blood circulates)

CONTRAST:
・{回|まわ}る (intransitive): X turns
・{回|まわ}す (transitive): turn X

RELATED:
・{回転|かいてん} (rotation—noun)
・{一回|いっかい}り (one round, one lap)
